# St. Mary's University Institutional Repository

> > Digital archive of academic research, theses, dissertations, and scholarly outputs from St. Mary's University, Ethiopia.

The repository is powered by DSpace and managed by the Research and Knowledge Management Office (RaKMO), providing open access to Ethiopian academic research and institutional knowledge. It serves as the primary digital library for preserving and disseminating scholarly work from St. Mary's University community.
